Ana R.: Heads-up — around 09:12 UTC we're seeing tail latency spikes on small generation endpoints. P50 fine, p99 ~3-4x. KV prefix hit-rate dropped from ~96% -> ~2.8% within ~3m. Anyone on call?
Tina OpsBot: Incident detected: kv-cache.hitrate < 5% for shard=12. Alerting eng-runtime.
Josh H.: Running `rdwctl metrics kv-cache --shard 12 --range 10m` now. Output: ```hit_rate: 0.028
evictions_per_sec: 1500
resident_slots: 2048/2048
avg_key_len: 184``` Looks like eviction thrash + very high unique key cardinality.
Priya K.: Can you paste a few sample keys so we can see pattern? Suspect prefix poisoning from streaming session ids.
Josh H.: Samples: `conv:acct:2234:prefix:session_53b2f...`
`conv:acct:2234:prefix:session_7a9c1...`
`conv:acct:2234:prefix:session_a0f9e...`
Many keys differ only by appended incremental token; cardinality exploded.
Marc L.: I also grabbed a pprof during the window. The lookup hot path shows a lot of time in `kv::lookup_hash` and retries due to eviction churn. Also saw kernel selection flipping to slower matmul path because seq_len heuristics saw a set of long-ish tokens after misses. Snippet: ```pprof: flat  58.1%  kv::lookup_hash
logs/kernel_select: seq_len=1152 -> chosen_kernel=matmul_generic``` That double-whammy (cache miss + slow kernel) explains p99 surge.
Kevin S.: Throttled the tenant at edge and temporarily increased shard 12 cache allocation. Command used: `rdwctl tenant throttle acme-stream --rps 10` and `rdwctl cache set-shard-size --shard 12 --size 50GB`.
Ana R.: After throttle + size bump: hit_rate rose to ~68% within 4m and tail latency returned to baseline. Nice quick mitigation, but need root cause & durable fixes. :thumbsup:
Josh H.: Hypothesis: streaming clients append session-specific suffixes per message (no normalization) -> prefix cardinality explosion -> LRU eviction thrash. Also some requests trigger seq_len variability which causes the kernel selector to pick slower kernels on misses. Suggested fixes: prefix normalization middleware, prefix-compression, and consider aged-LRU (LRU2) eviction.
Priya K.: Agreed. I'll open a PR for a prefix-normalizer that hashes long session suffixes or folds them into a bounded token. Also proposing a metric rule: if kv-cache global hit_rate < 10% for >2m then auto-scale cache or shift eviction policy.
Marc L.: I'll run perf experiments: synthetic workloads with 5k unique prefixes vs normalized 50 prefixes to measure eviction and kernel selection impact. Plan: simulate both and capture p99 and throughput, then add a controlled kernel-selection guard to prefer latency-optimized kernel when cache miss rate > threshold.
Ana R.: Action items: 1) Tenant throttle playbook (ops) 2) Prefix normalizer middleware (Priya) 3) Cache alert -> auto-scale policy (Josh) 4) Kernel-selection guard (Marc) 5) E2E test to catch prefix-cardinality regressions (Kevin). Please add ETA in a shared doc.
DeployBot: Scheduled action: temporary shard size increase for shard=12 applied, will auto-rollback in 2h unless ops extends.
Kevin S.: I'll follow up with a quick runbook entry so support can throttle noisy tenants without waiting for infra changes.
Ana R.: Thanks all — filing short postmortem and linking perf outputs. We'll follow up in next eng-runtime sync.
